title: Projected proportional-symbol map
intent: Compare place magnitudes with area-scaled circles over a projected world map.

ai.create: Create a proportional-symbol world map from seven region polygons and nine GeoJSON places, using the same Equal Earth projection and square-root radius scale in both renderers.
ai.maintain: Keep longitude and latitude semantic, sort-independent, and projection-backed; preserve stable place keys and area-scaled D3 point radii.
